title.en: Is Saviku a property management system, or a chatbot?
title.sw_ke: Je, Saviku ni mfumo wa kusimamia mali, au chatbot?
title.sw_tz: Je, Saviku ni mfumo wa kusimamia mali, au chatbot?

answer.en: Both. Properties, availability, rates, restrictions and reservations all live in one PMS record per property, checked every minute and synced out to your connected channels. The 24/7 AI co-host is the WhatsApp conversation layered on top of it — not a separate product.

examples: do i need to install anything
do i need to download an app

title.en: Do I need to install anything?

answer.en: No. Saviku runs inside WhatsApp on the number you already use. A web page opens only for the few things a bigger screen does better — a document photo, a signature, a date grid — and it takes you straight back to the chat.

Savi is hybrid: deterministic automation handles structured actions and keeps every money or identity step on fixed, auditable paths; AI helps understand eligible free-text requests and route them to approved actions; and a human concierge steps in when context or judgement is needed. AI never invents payment, identity or release instructions.

Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia and Vrbo connect through realtime two-way channel sync. Reservations flow into Saviku, and the availability, rates and restrictions (ARI) you set from WhatsApp flow back out — checked every minute, not on a scheduled calendar refresh.

examples: can two channels double-book the same night
can two channels book the same night

title.en: Can two channels double-book the same night?
title.sw_ke: Je, njia mbili zinaweza kuhifadhi usiku mmoja mara mbili?
title.sw_tz: Je, njia mbili zinaweza kuhifadhi usiku mmoja mara mbili?

answer.en: Saviku checks new bookings against dates already reserved and sends availability updates to connected channels. Separate channels can still accept bookings before an update arrives, so simultaneous bookings or sync delays can cause conflicts. Saviku flags conflicting incoming bookings for review; channel updates are not an instant guarantee.

examples: how does saviku protect my money
how does the 48-hour booking protection work

title.en: How does the 48-Hour Booking Protection work?

answer.en:
Secure Booking: Your payment is processed through Saviku’s payment provider, allocated to your booking and not paid directly to the host at collection.

Protection Window: You have 48 hours after scheduled check-in to cancel or report a material problem.

Host Payout: If no eligible cancellation or dispute is open, Saviku instructs the provider to pay the verified host after that window, subject to provider availability.

Guest Guarantee: If any critical listing or access issues occur, you are covered under Saviku’s booking protection policy.

examples: when does the host get paid
when do hosts receive their payout

title.en: When do hosts receive their payout?

answer.en:
Predictable 48-Hour Payouts

Host payout is scheduled to your registered M-PESA or approved account 48 hours after scheduled check-in, minus Saviku's disclosed service fee, unless an eligible cancellation or dispute is open.

examples: can agents and property managers use it

title.en: Can agents and property managers use it?
title.sw_ke: Je, mawakala na wasimamizi wa mali wanaweza kuitumia?
title.sw_tz: Je, mawakala na wasimamizi wa mali wanaweza kuitumia?

answer.en: Yes. Agents follow the same verification ladder plus referee confirmations, and get a shareable profile that shows bookings completed through Saviku’s booking-protection flow and any diversion reports — nothing self-declared.

examples: can i get my money back after check-in

answer.en: If you cancel before paying, nothing is charged. While your payment is still held, an eligible cancellation or an upheld dispute can lead to a full or partial refund, decided under the Saviku refund policy. Refunds go back to the number that paid. Once the host has been paid, refunds follow the host's terms and Saviku cannot refund or recover that payment. Your booking card links the full policy.

examples: what if the place isn't as advertised
what if the place is not as described
the listing was different from the place

title.en: If the place is not as advertised

answer.en: If the place is not what the listing promised — the photos, the location, or an amenity that is missing — raise it from your booking while Saviku is still holding the payment. A Saviku reviewer decides under the stays terms. A validated claim can be a full refund, including the protection fee. Once the host has been paid, that payment is no longer in the hold. Cancel my stay on your booking card is what starts this.

examples: ada ya saviku ni kiasi gani

answer.en: Saviku charges a small protection fee on protected stays, shared between the guest and the host. Your booking card shows the exact amount before you pay, so there are no surprises.

answer.en: You pay with M-Pesa. Open your booking card, tap pay, and approve the M-Pesa prompt that appears on your phone. Your booking is confirmed once the payment goes through.

title.en: M-Pesa prompt did not come or payment failed
title.sw_ke: Ombi la M-Pesa halikuja au malipo yameshindwa
title.sw_tz: Ombi la M-Pesa halikuja au malipo yameshindwa

answer.en: Check that the number you are paying with is the one on your M-Pesa, that it has enough balance, and that your phone has signal, then try again from your booking card. If money left your account but your booking is not confirmed, contact Savi support and have your M-Pesa message ready.
answer.sw_ke: Hakikisha namba unayolipia ndiyo ya M-Pesa yako, ina salio la kutosha, na simu ina mtandao, kisha jaribu tena kutoka kwa kadi ya booking yako. Kama pesa zimetoka lakini booking haijathibitishwa, wasiliana na msaada wa Savi ukiwa na ujumbe wako wa M-Pesa.
answer.sw_tz: Hakikisha namba unayolipia ndiyo ya M-Pesa yako, ina salio la kutosha, na simu ina mtandao, kisha jaribu tena kutoka kwenye kadi ya uhifadhi wako. Kama pesa zimetoka lakini uhifadhi haujathibitishwa, wasiliana na msaada wa Savi ukiwa na ujumbe wako wa M-Pesa.

answer.en: Hosts verify so they can receive payouts. Tap Get verified in the main menu, agree to the privacy notice, send your ID and a selfie, and add your M-Pesa payout number. It takes about two minutes.
